questions.question: Explain the evolution from Computer Reservation Systems (CRS) to Global Distribution Systems (GDS) and their role in tourism distribution.
questions.solution_html:
• Distribution Systems (GDS) and their role in tourism distribution.
  • CRS originated for airline seat reservation, initially airline-specific/internal systems
  • expanded to include hotels, cars, rail, etc., Became GDS with multi-supplier, global access
  • Examples: Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo, Worldspan, Role in tourism distribution: central
  • inventory, real-time booking, wider reach, travel agent access, efficiency, price comparison
  • Impact on modern tourism
questions.final_answer: Impact on modern tourism

questions.question: Explain the delivery and management process in an online business with diagrams.

  • Delivery/service fulfilment, Customer support and feedback, Use of management systems

  • Content Management + Inventory Management + Payment Security + CRM + Analytics →
  • Efficient Online Business Operation
